narrative: HEAD matched the controlled SHA. The tracked repository is a bounded AAOS vehicle-HAL/service closure with 17 active named Soong declarations, including defaults and generated/filegroup declarations; the legacy Android.mk is also a build entry point but declares no named local module. Production code has capability-oriented packages but no required production UI/domain/data responsibility-layer directory markers. The complete local declared-dependency graph is acyclic, although root source aggregators overlap separately declared service/support boundaries. SOLID evidence is mixed: transport substitution and compatibility seams are strong and tested, while large coordinators, broad callbacks, and concrete default construction constrain SRP, ISP, and DIP. Compilation remains tied to platform APIs. CI evidence is limited to Android TEST_MAPPING and pre-upload hooks. API compatibility has concrete stable-AIDL and source-level compatibility controls. Ref comparisons covered main against both platform branches, platform-to-platform, release, and the SOP tag; they show shared main code plus small platform-specific branches. No files were modified, and no build or external operation was performed.
